Method source hashes include declaration through closing brace; UTF-8 LF normalized by Python read_text, no trailing newline; line ranges are one-based.

rules.acceptance: Actual bone meal right-click on an unripe blueberry bush does not consume the item, add berry age or emit successful fertilizer feedback; natural random growth still works under its own conditions.
